commitments.detail: Update the draft plan to replace LMS-based instruction with email-distributed PDFs available by 7:30 a.m., replace bus-route meal delivery with on-site pickup at North and South Campuses from 11:00 a.m. to 1:00 p.m., replace school voicemail with a staffed nurse hotline from 8:00 a.m. to 12:00 p.m., and add printed packets plus bilingual phone check-ins for 38 households without reliable internet.
Attach the vendor maintenance notice, transportation storm route review results, nurse coverage roster, and family-access summary to the briefing packet before final sign-off.

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical issue for tomorrow's remote day plan. The district's learning-management-system authentication will be offline for scheduled maintenance from 8:00 to 11:00 a.m. tomorrow. I confirmed the maintenance window with the vendor today, but the vendor notice hasn't been attached to the remote-day draft yet. This means instruction scheduled through the LMS at 8:00 a.m. won't be accessible. Instead, instructional files must be distributed by email as downloadable PDFs and made available for printing by 7:30 a.m. We need to revise the draft plan before Dr. Lee signs off.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to add critical information to the plan before Dr. Lee signs off. My family outreach confirmations from this week show that 38 households lack reliable internet access. Those families will need printed learning packets plus bilingual phone check-ins in Spanish and Somali. The family-access summary is still being compiled and hasn't made it into the draft plan yet, so this gap isn't reflected. Between Mr. Brooks's LMS issue and these offline households, we have significant access problems that the current draft doesn't address.

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical transportation issue before Dr. Lee signs off. My department's storm route review, completed this afternoon, found that no buses can safely travel tomorrow. This means we cannot send meals by regular bus routes as the current draft plan assumes. Instead, meals can be made available for on-site pickup at North Campus and South Campus from 11:00 a.m. to 1:00 p.m. The route review results have not yet been added to the operations briefing packet, so this gap isn't reflected in the draft plan.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical health-services issue before Dr. Lee signs off. The district nurse coverage plan requires the usual school voicemail to be replaced entirely by a staffed nurse hotline from 8:00 a.m. to 12:00 p.m. tomorrow for students who need medication or urgent health guidance during remote instruction. Voicemail is not to be used as a fallback or co-equal channel during this window. I confirmed the coverage roster this afternoon, but it has not yet been entered in the draft plan. The current draft directing health questions to the usual school voicemail is not compliant with this requirement.
